job_title: AI / ML & Full-Stack Software Engineer (Graduate / Entry-Level)
pool_summary: The pool divides into a small top tier with unusually strong research outputs, advanced AI system work, selective international or lab experience, and evidence of measurable impact. A larger middle tier demonstrates credible full-stack delivery or applied ML projects, while many applicants provide primarily skills lists, coursework, or limited project evidence.

axes.label: Published Research Depth
axes.rationale: For an applied AI/ML engineering role, demonstrated research execution is a stronger differentiator than generic ML coursework. Publication, funded research, or technically rigorous research programs indicate the ability to investigate ambiguous problems and communicate results.
axes.strong_criteria: Published or accepted peer-reviewed work, multiple substantive lab projects, or research involving novel methods and formal evaluation.
axes.moderate_criteria: A supervised research internship, literature-based project, or technically relevant research contribution without a publication or clearly documented novel result.

supporting_claims.digest_line: Projects: Presented a Conference Paper at FIT 2024
supporting_claims.evidence_span: Published a Conference paper related to my Final year project on "Routing through Satellite Imagery"

supporting_claims.digest_line: Projects: FUSIONRAG: Enhancing Regulatory Document Analysis
supporting_claims.evidence_span: Published at COLING 2025.
Worked on a €80,000 DAAD-funded project in collaboration with RPTU & DFKI, where I interned in Germany.

supporting_claims.digest_line: Projects: Enhancing Vehicle Routing with Time Windows
supporting_claims.evidence_span: Authored a research paper focusing on integrating machine learning techniques with Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) to improve vehicle routing under time-window constraints.

axes.label: Production System Complexity
axes.rationale: The role combines AI with product engineering, so candidates must be able to connect models and APIs to usable, stateful products. Complex full-stack systems with authentication, realtime communication, multiple clients, or deployment are more predictive than isolated demos.
axes.strong_criteria: Built and integrated a complete product across frontend, backend, data, authentication, realtime or external APIs, with evidence of deployment, scalability, or multiple user surfaces.
axes.moderate_criteria: Delivered a functional web or mobile application with a conventional frontend/backend stack, but limited evidence of production concerns or system complexity.

supporting_claims.evidence_span: A React and React Flow-based workflow editor enabling users to create, edit, and visualize flows with customizable nodes, drag-and-drop editing, real-time updates, and state persistence.
Developed a real-time chat application using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) to facilitate communication for up to 100 concurrent users.

supporting_claims.digest_line: Projects: Mobile App Using React Native - FindMyStay
supporting_claims.evidence_span: The app includes complete backend functionality using Node.js and MongoDB, along with a responsive UI built in React Native. It integrates features like user authentication, property listings, booking management, and real-time notifications.
Developing a scalable management system targeted for 100+ daily users.
I contributed to enhancing the platform by adding new vendor categories to both the web-based user portal (built with Next.js) and the vendor app (React Native).

axes.label: Advanced AI Integration
axes.rationale: The target role explicitly mentions LLMs, RAG, computer vision, and predictive modeling. Candidates stand out when they combine modern model architectures with retrieval, multimodal fusion, serving, or quantitative evaluation rather than merely listing frameworks.
axes.strong_criteria: Implemented an advanced LLM/RAG, multimodal, or computer-vision pipeline and reported evaluation metrics, retrieval components, latency, or deployment-oriented constraints.
axes.moderate_criteria: Built a working ML or deep-learning application using established models, but with limited architectural detail or evaluation evidence.

supporting_claims.evidence_span: Developed a medical visual question-answering system using CNNs for image features and LSTMs/Transformers for text queries. Implemented multimodal fusion to combine image and text features.

supporting_claims.digest_line: Projects: FUSIONRAG: Enhancing Regulatory Document Analysis
supporting_claims.evidence_span: Developed FUSIONRAG, combining OpenAI embeddings, BM25, FAISS, and Rank-Fusion for improved regulatory information retrieval and answer generation.

Developed a system to identify fake reviews using advanced natural language processing models (BERT, RoBERTa, XLNet, GPT-2). Fine-tuned each model on a labeled dataset of real and fake reviews for classification purposes.
RoBERTa fine-tuned with Low Rank Adaptation to detect change in writing style at paragraph level achieved an F1 Score of 0.80.

supporting_claims.digest_line: Work: Deutsches Forschungszentrum für Künstliche Intelligenz
supporting_claims.evidence_span: Engineered a semi-supervised model for detecting informal settlements using remote sensing. Applied techniques like FixMatch, domain adaptation between cities and pseudo-label refinement via SAM2.

axes.label: Selective External Environments
axes.rationale: Selective labs, international research placements, and collaborations with recognized universities expose entry-level engineers to stronger technical standards and diverse problem settings. This matters for a role seeking candidates who can operate beyond classroom assignments.
axes.strong_criteria: Substantive technical work with a recognized international university, research center, funded lab, or selective global program, rather than merely attending an exchange.
axes.moderate_criteria: A university lab internship, local research assistantship, exchange semester, or externally supervised project with some technical responsibility.

supporting_claims.digest_line: Work: NUSTIAN USA International Summer Research Internship Program
supporting_claims.evidence_span: Collaborated with Prof. Zubair Shafique from UC Davis on the project “A Graph-based ML Approach to Detecting JavaScript-based Online Tracking.”

supporting_claims.digest_line: Work: Deutsches Forschungszentrum für Künstliche Intelligenz

Held technical roles or internships with Nanyang Technological University in Singapore, the HPC Lab at SEECS, Radar Research Lab at SINES, and multiple remote organizations.

axes.label: Quantified Real-World Impact
axes.rationale: Because the position targets production AI and product engineering, measurable outcomes help separate candidates who merely built prototypes from those who improved a system, user behavior, model performance, or operational workflow.
axes.strong_criteria: Reports a credible metric tied to deployment, users, data volume, model evaluation, efficiency, adoption, or business outcome, ideally across a nontrivial project.
axes.moderate_criteria: Includes a basic model accuracy, usage target, or qualitative deployment statement, but lacks a clear baseline, context, or operational consequence.

supporting_claims.evidence_span: Published as an npm package with 500+ downloads and has 5 Stars on GitHub.

Utilized the FER2013Plus dataset for emotion recognition and ResNet50 as the base CNN model, achieving an 82.7% accuracy.
